description: Elden Ring game art style — dark fantasy illustration

model._hint: DreamBooth fine-tune on SD 1.5, trained on Elden Ring game art (3000 steps, prior-preservation loss). ~2 GB. Trigger word: 'elden ring style'. Recommended sampler: DDIM. No VAE override needed.

generation._hint: Model card: 35 steps / CFG 7 for portraits (512×704), 30 steps for landscapes (1024×576). DDIM sampler. Range: 25–40 steps. 512 base resolution — SD 1.5 native.

system._hint: ~2 GB peak; sequential_cpu_offload: disabled (fits comfortably in 16 GB unified memory)

notes.about: DreamBooth fine-tune of Stable Diffusion 1.5 on Elden Ring game art by nitrosocke. Generates dark fantasy illustrations in the distinctive Elden Ring aesthetic — ornate armour, moody landscapes, dramatic lighting, FromSoftware character style.
notes.prompt_guide:
TRIGGER WORD REQUIRED: include 'elden ring style' in every prompt.

Portrait examples:
'elden ring style portrait of a beautiful woman highly detailed 8k'
'a magical princess with golden hair, elden ring style'
'elden ring style knight in ornate armour, dramatic lighting, highly detailed'

Landscape examples:
'elden ring style dark blue night castle on a cliff, dark night, giant birds'
'elden ring style ruined cathedral at dusk, fog, epic scale'

Negative prompt: 'bright day' works well for moody landscapes. General: 'blurry, low quality, out of frame, deformed'.
